lastCompletedStory.title: Notify-on-drain via a drain-specific Resend message (reuse client, not the escalateFn)

nextStoryContext: US-005 added DRAIN_NOTIFY_SUBJECT, makeProductionDrainNotifyFn, and updated makeProductionMetaLoopObserveFn (now async, accepts resendApiKey/resendRecipient, builds drainNotifyFn internally) in sidecar.ts. The drain notify fn reuses readResendConfig + sendEscalation with the drain subject/body; no second Resend client is instantiated. Tests extended makeTestObserveFn to accept optional drainNotifyFn and be async, with 6 new US-005 drain notification test cases covering: configured->1 call, drain subject not Non-convergence, unconfigured->0 calls, dedup->1 call across 5 ticks, and 2 file-assert oracles. File-size budget raised: sidecar.ts 611->667, test/commands/sidecar-meta-loop.test.ts 371->550.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Resend emails.send() requires from, to, subject. Returns { data: { id }, error: null } on success. Our sendEscalation wrapper correctly checks error!==null, passes from/to/subject/html, and injects a sendFn for tests. API confirmed matches implementation.
